commits.comment: KV cache 布局重构第 5 部分：引入后端发布 KV packing 的 customize_spec 钩子。AttentionBackend 新增 customize_spec 类方法（默认原样返回），各后端可根据自身 kernel 的 packed 布局调整 AttentionSpec 的 num_head_slots/state_content_bytes。移除了 TQFullAttentionSpec，TurboQuant 改用 KVQuantMode 枚举（TURBOQUANT_K8V4/4BIT_NC/K3V4_NC/3BIT_NC）配合 customize_spec 发布槽大小。AttentionSpec 将 head_size_v 上提为基类字段，unpadded_page_size_bytes 统一为 num_heads * storage_block_size * state_content_size_bytes，real_page_size_bytes 变为 unpadded 的别名；MLAAttentionSpec 默认 head_size_v=0，SlidingWindowMLASpec 新增 model_version 断言。FlashInfer/Triton/TurboQuant/MLA 各自实现 customize_spec 发布 NVFP4/per-token-head/TQ/MLA packing 规则。Platform.verify_custom_kv_cache_specs 与 worker get_kv_cache_spec 路径均改为调用 backend.customize_spec(spec)。风险点：依赖旧页面大小公式的代码需跟随新字段语义迁移，OOT 平台的注意力后端若未实现 customize_spec 且使用非 dense packing，页面大小计算会与上游不一致。

ascend_impact.functionality: AttentionBackend 基类（vllm/v1/attention/backend.py）新增 customize_spec 类方法，AscendAttentionBackend 家族继承后若未覆写则使用默认实现，无法发布 per-token-head/TQ/NVFP4 等 packed 布局的 state_content_bytes，导致 KV cache 页面大小计算（unpadded_page_size_bytes）与上游新语义不一致。AttentionSpec/KVQuantMode（vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py）新增 head_size_v、num_head_slots、state_content_bytes 字段并改写 real_page_size_bytes 为 unpadded 别名，Ascend 自定义 spec（AscendMLAAttentionSpec 等）若依赖旧公式需同步迁移。SlidingWindowMLASpec.__post_init__ 新增 model_version 必须在 (None, 'deepseek_v4') 中的断言，Ascend 若使用其他 model_version 字符串会直接触发断言失败。Platform 接口（vllm/platforms/interface.py）中 per_token_page_bytes 与 TQ 页面大小计算改为 backend_cls.customize_spec，NPUPlatform 继承的基类逻辑会将 AscendAttentionBackend 的 hook 返回值作为页面大小依据。worker 的 get_kv_cache_spec 循环（attn_utils.py / gpu_model_runner.py）也新增 customize_spec 调用。

commits.message:
[5/N][KV-Cache Layout Refactor] Backend-published KV packing via customize_spec (#51704)

Signed-off-by: Lucas Wilkinson <lwilkins@redhat.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/attention/*.py — AscendAttentionBackend / AscendMLABackend / AscendSFABackend / AscendDSABackend / AscendFABackend (subclasses of AttentionBackend, new customize_spec classmethod)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This commit ([5/N] KV-Cache Layout Refactor) adds a new `AttentionBackend.customize_spec(cls, spec)` hook (default identity), moves `head_size_v` into the `AttentionSpec` base, adds `num_head_slots`/`state_content_bytes` fields, unifies `real_page_size_bytes` = `unpadded_page_size_bytes = num_heads * storage_block_size * state_content_size_bytes`, deletes `TQFullAttentionSpec`, and splits `KVQuantMode.TURBOQUANT` into TURBOQUANT_K8V4/4BIT_NC/K3V4_NC/3BIT_NC. Upstream `vllm/v1/worker/gpu/attn_utils.py:get_kv_cache_spec` and `vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py:get_kv_cache_spec` now call `backend.customize_spec(spec)` after building specs. Nothing breaks today (vllm-ascend does not use the removed symbols; its spec subclasses override page_size_bytes/real_page_size_bytes/storage_block_size, and all Ascend spec constructions leave `alignment=None`, so the new `AttentionSpec.__post_init__`/`_apply_alignment_padding` formula changes are inert). Required adaptation: (1) In `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/attn_utils.py:get_kv_cache_spec`, mirror the upstream change and call `backend.customize_spec(spec)` (e.g. after the `indexes_kv_by_block_stride` step) so the patched replacement stays in sync with the new upstream contract; (2) decide whether the Ascend backends should publish their packing (DSA/DSV4 584B `state_content_bytes`, SFA indexer scale dims, NZ layout, `scale_dim`/`scale_dtype`) via `customize_spec` + the new `state_content_bytes`/`num_head_slots` fields instead of the existing `page_size_bytes` overrides in `vllm_ascend/core/kv_cache_interface.py`; (3) verify no reliance on the old `MLAAttentionSpec.head_size_v` value (now 0 instead of head_size) in `_get_attention_kv_cache_dims`/`_reshape_kv_cache_v2` (the AscendMLA/DSA paths already bypass it, so no change needed today); (4) re-run `tests/ut/worker/test_model_runner_v2_mamba.py` (its `FullAttentionSpec.real_page_size_bytes == 16` assertion still holds under the new formula) and any KV-cache spec/registry UT.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. No current functional breakage because `customize_spec` defaults to identity and Ascend spec subclasses override page-size properties. The real risk is silent contract drift: vllm-ascend's patched `get_kv_cache_spec` bypasses `customize_spec`, so when later commits in this series ([6/N]+) make backend-published packing the authoritative path, Ascend KV caches could be mis-sized (page_size_bytes mismatch leading to under-allocation or reshape failures) without an immediate error. Keep the patched `get_kv_cache_spec` aligned with upstream and re-verify on each follow-up commit of the KV-Cache Layout Refactor series.

commits.message:
[MRV2][Multimodal] Enable encoder cuda graph for model runner v2 (#49852)

Signed-off-by: Isotr0py <Isotr0py@outlook.com>
Co-authored-by: OpenAI Codex <codex@openai.com>

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This commit enables encoder CUDA graph for Model Runner V2: (1) ModelState.__init__ now builds an EncoderCudaGraphManager when `not enforce_eager and compilation_config.cudagraph_mm_encoder and supports_encoder_cudagraph(model)` and injects it into EncoderRunner; (2) EncoderRunner gains cudagraph_manager/has_cudagraph()/capture()/clear() and its encode() dispatches to the manager when is_captured() && supports_modality(); (3) GPUModelRunner.compile_or_warm_up_model() calls encoder_runner.capture() and shutdown() calls encoder_runner.clear(); (4) encoder_cudagraph.py adds is_captured(). vllm-ascend's v2 path is directly affected: NPUModelRunner(GPUModelRunner) inherits compile_or_warm_up_model/shutdown, and AscendModelState/AscendMambaHybridModelState inherit the upstream ModelState.__init__. With cudagraph_mm_encoder enabled on a multimodal model, the upstream plain EncoderCudaGraphManager would be constructed; it is CUDA-only (torch.cuda.CUDAGraph/torch.cuda.graph) and its plain replay lacks the NPU FIA graph_task_update (update_encoder_graph_params) handling, so it crashes or produces wrong encoder embeddings on NPU. Adaptation steps: (1) Wire the existing EncoderAclGraphManager (vllm_ascend/worker/encoder_acl_graph.py) into the MRV2 model-state construction path, mirroring the v1 pattern (model_runner_v1.py _replace_gpu_model_runner_function_wrapper) — e.g. a worker patch (patch_v2/patch_model_state.py) that rebinds EncoderCudaGraphManager -> EncoderAclGraphManager in vllm.v1.worker.encoder_cudagraph so the upstream ModelState.__init__/EncoderRunner build the NPU manager; (2) replace graph_capture in vllm.v1.worker.gpu.mm.encoder_runner with the NPU graph_capture (as done for v1, model_runner_v1.py:240) since upstream parallel_state.graph_capture is CUDA-only; (3) in NPUModelRunner, set encoder_runner.cudagraph_manager.update_stream = self.update_stream after capture (mirror model_runner_v1.py:4893-4895), required by EncoderAclGraphManager._run_budget_graph for FIA host-arg updates; (4) fix is_captured() semantics for the Ascend manager: EncoderAclGraphManager.__init__/capture set self.graph_pool to a non-None global pool, so the new is_captured() returns True before any graph is captured, causing _execute_local -> _run_budget_graph to return None for empty graph sets and hit `assert output is not None`; override is_captured() (e.g. track a separate captured flag or gate on budget_graphs) and keep the weak_ref_tensors output-buffer handling; (5) validate the `current_platform.graph_pool_handle()` resolution (Platform.__getattr__ falls back to torch.npu.graph_pool_handle) in EncoderRunner.capture(). Behavior-neutral when the flag is off (cudagraph_mm_encoder defaults to False), so only the opt-in multimodal MRV2 path needs work.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. Without adaptation, enabling cudagraph_mm_encoder on a multimodal MRV2 model on Ascend will (a) fail during compile_or_warm_up_model because EncoderRunner.capture() uses CUDA graph_capture and the plain manager uses torch.cuda.CUDAGraph on a device with no CUDA device, or (b) if capture is bypassed, the new is_captured() gate (which is always True for EncoderAclGraphManager because graph_pool is set at init) routes encode() into the graph path whose empty graph_set triggers an assertion; even a successful plain capture/replay would skip update_encoder_graph_params, producing incorrect FIA attention results. The change is additive/opt-in (defaults off) so existing Ascend v2 multimodal deployments are unaffected until the flag is turned on; the v1 encoder-ACL-graph machinery already exists to reuse, but the v2 integration touches the shared model-state and runner warm-up path used by all v2 workloads and should be validated with NPU e2e multimodal (e.g. Qwen2.5-VL) and dual-path encoder tests.

XPU 主导的 PP async-scheduling 优化：将 PP 的 sampled-token broadcast 改为 torch.distributed.broadcast(..., async_op=True)，使广播通信与后续计算重叠；在 _prepare_input_ids 读取 prev_sampled_token_ids 前对 self._pp_recv_work 执行 wait() 并清空，确保不会读到未完成的广播数据。该行为是平台无关的模型运行器级变更。

ascend_impact.functionality: 变更位于 vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py（v1 架构 GPUModelRunner 路径，NPUModelRunnerV1 对应目标）。PP + async scheduling 下 broadcast 变为异步等待模式，依赖 torch.distributed 异步 Work 在 HCCL 后端的正确性；NPU 上需要确保 _pp_recv_work 的 wait 点在读取 prev_sampled_token_ids 前生效，且不影响 chunked prefill 的跳过逻辑。
ascend_impact.testing: 需要在 Ascend NPU 上验证 pipeline parallel + async scheduling 组合场景，尤其是 broadcast 与计算重叠后的数据正确性。

commits.comment: 为 Model Runner V2 的多层 MTP 推测解码增加完整的 KV cache 支持。核心变更：(1) SlidingWindowSpec 新增 extra_retained_tokens 字段（默认 0），滑动窗口尾沿额外保留 tokens 以便 store-side 重建窗口，SlidingWindowMLASpec.merge 要求同组 spec 该字段一致；(2) KVCacheCoordinator/KVCacheManager 新增 num_prefill_lookahead 参数（默认 0），前缀缓存只缓存 KV 已 finalize 的 tokens（排除可 re-prefill 的尾部），并新增 scheduler_block_size >= num_speculative_tokens 的校验；(3) Scheduler 新增 num_prefill_lookahead 属性（Eagle 家族为 1、多层 MTP 为 num_spec_tokens），_reserve_prefill_lookahead 避免 chunk 边界落入 lookahead 窗口，encoder 调度 shift 与 encoder free deferral 同步调整；(4) SpeculativeConfig 放开 Inkling MTP 深度限制（n_predict = checkpoint_depths）；(5) GPU spec_decode 注册 MultiModuleMTPSpeculator。所有新增参数/字段均有默认值，既有配置行为不变。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py（必然影响路径）中 SlidingWindowSpec 新增 extra_retained_tokens: int = 0 字段，SlidingWindowMLASpec.merge 现在要求同组 spec 的 extra_retained_tokens 一致，replace_as 新增 drop 参数；vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py 的 Scheduler 新增 num_prefill_lookahead 属性（默认 0）并在 KVCacheManager/KVCacheCoordinator 构造链中透传（默认 0）。Ascend 的 AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec 等自定义 spec 继承新字段但默认值为 0，行为不变；Ascend 若直接继承 vLLM Scheduler 则自动获得该逻辑。真正触发行为变化仅在启用 multi-module MTP（use_multi_module_mtp）时：前缀缓存 + 多层 MTP 要求 scheduler_block_size >= num_speculative_tokens（否则抛 ValueError），且 vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/__init__.py 中注册的 MultiModuleMTPSpeculator 属于 GPU worker 路径，Ascend 若要支持需要自行注册并处理 KV scale 复制等逻辑。
ascend_impact.testing: Ascend 的滑动窗口 KV cache 与 spec decode 相关测试在默认参数（extra_retained_tokens=0、num_prefill_lookahead=0）下行为不变；若启用多层 MTP，需验证 scheduler_block_size 校验和前缀缓存对齐行为。

affected_interfaces: Scheduler subclasses with copied schedule() bodies: RecomputeScheduler (vllm_ascend/core/recompute_scheduler.py), ProfilingChunkScheduler (vllm_ascend/core/scheduler_profiling_chunk.py), DyntraLBScheduler (vllm_ascend/core/dyntra_lb_scheduler.py), BalanceScheduler (vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_balance_schedule.py)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
This commit ('[Model Runner V2][Spec Decode] Add KV cache support for multi-layer MTP') adds a `num_prefill_lookahead` parameter to KVCacheCoordinator/UnitaryKVCacheCoordinator/HybridKVCacheCoordinator/KVCacheCoordinatorNoPrefixCache/get_kv_cache_coordinator, wires it through KVCacheManager.__init__, adds `SlidingWindowSpec.extra_retained_tokens` (with tagging in get_kv_cache_configs and handling in SlidingWindowManager.get_num_skipped_tokens/max_memory_usage_bytes/SlidingWindowMLASpec.merge/replace_as drop=), changes Scheduler.schedule() to use `shift_computed_tokens=self.num_prefill_lookahead` plus a new `_reserve_prefill_lookahead()`, changes `_free_encoder_inputs` lookahead, and adds a MultiModuleMTPSpeculator branch to the GPU init_speculator. Required vllm-ascend adaptations:

1. HARD BREAK (startup TypeError for every config): vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py:390 `get_kv_cache_coordinator(...)` has a fixed signature lacking the new `num_prefill_lookahead` kwarg that KVCacheManager.__init__ now always forwards (vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_manager.py:152). Add `num_prefill_lookahead: int = 0` and forward it to both AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator calls and to `_orig_get_kv_cache_coordinator(**orig_kwargs)`.

2. AttributeError on DeepSeek-V4 path: AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator.__init__ (patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py:76) does NOT call super().__init__(), so it never sets the new `self.num_reprefillable_tokens = max(0, num_prefill_lookahead - 1)`. After this commit, the inherited HybridKVCacheCoordinator.cache_blocks reads `self.num_reprefillable_tokens`. Accept the new param and set the attribute explicitly (optionally replicate the new eagle+prefix-caching `scheduler_block_size < num_prefill_lookahead` validation).

3. Scheduler copies: the four copied schedule() bodies use `shift_computed_tokens=1 if self.use_eagle else 0` at two sites each (recompute_scheduler.py:311,694; scheduler_profiling_chunk.py:311,588; dyntra_lb_scheduler.py:531,891; patch_balance_schedule.py:270,586). Replace with `self.num_prefill_lookahead` and add `num_new_tokens = self._reserve_prefill_lookahead(request, num_computed_tokens, num_new_tokens)` after the encoder-scheduling calls in both RUNNING and WAITING loops (handling the new num_new_tokens==0 reason). The `_reserve_prefill_lookahead` method and `self.num_prefill_lookahead` attribute are inherited from the base Scheduler (attribute set in Scheduler.__init__), and `_free_encoder_inputs` is also inherited, so only the copied schedule() bodies need editing.

4. KVCacheSpec: vllm_ascend/core/kv_cache_interface.py `AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec.merge()` (line 192) constructs `cls(...)` without the new inherited `extra_retained_tokens` field, silently dropping it. Add a consistency assertion plus field propagation (mirror upstream SlidingWindowMLASpec.merge). This matters only when multi-module MTP is used with SWA-MLA layers, but is cheap to add.

5. spec_decode: vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/__init__.py init_speculator intercepts `method == 'mtp'` before upstream's new `use_multi_module_mtp()` branch, routing multi-module MTP to AscendMTPSpeculator (a wrapper of upstream single-loop MTPSpeculator) instead of the new MultiModuleMTPSpeculator. If Ascend should support multi-module MTP (e.g. Inkling / Ling-3.0-Flash, or any mtp checkpoint with num_nextn_predict_layers > 1), add a corresponding branch; upstream SpeculativeConfig._verify_args also removed the 'Inkling MTP requires exactly one speculative token' restriction, so multi-module MTP now passes config validation.

Note: `extra_retained_tokens` tagging in get_kv_cache_configs happens before Ascend's patched group_and_unify_kv_cache_specs/_get_kv_cache_groups_uniform_groups run, and those wrap (not merge) specs, so the field survives that path unchanged.
deep_analysis.risk: High. (1) Without the get_kv_cache_coordinator signature fix, every Ascend engine start raises TypeError, including non-spec-decode configs, because KVCacheManager.__init__ unconditionally forwards num_prefill_lookahead. (2) Even after that fix, AscendHybridKVCacheCoordinator will raise AttributeError in cache_blocks on the DeepSeek-V4/hybrid path unless num_reprefillable_tokens is set. (3) If the copied schedulers are not updated, multi-module MTP (Inkling/Ling-3.0-Flash, mtp with num_nextn_predict_layers>1) will mis-schedule encoder inputs and defer frees with lookahead 1 instead of num_spec_tokens, and will not reserve the prefill-lookahead window, reproducing the exact KV-cache pollution/incorrect-draft-KV bugs this commit fixes (silent wrong outputs, no crash). (4) Dropping extra_retained_tokens in AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec.merge could under-retain trailing blocks for SWA-MLA MTP models. (5) Routing multi-module MTP into the single-module AscendMTPSpeculator may silently skip the per-module KV writes the upstream MultiModuleMTPSpeculator performs.

commits.comment: 重新应用 PR 50869（此前被 revert）：移除 SpeculativeConfig 中 DSpark 的 num_speculative_tokens >= dspark_block_size 硬校验。被删除的注释说明：DSpark 是半自回归 block drafter，speculative 长度小于 checkpoint block size 会向 block/Markov-head 机制传入不支持的布局并产生乱码输出。上游仍决定移除该校验（可能底层实现已修复，或该校验在部分场景误伤合法配置），但由于没有替换校验逻辑，此项约束在 vLLM 层彻底消失。对 DSpark 推测解码的配置合法性判断有直接影响。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/config/speculative.py（可能影响路径）移除了 DSpark 的 num_speculative_tokens 下限校验。vllm-ascend 的 spec_decode 目录包含 DSpark proposer，移除该约束后，Ascend 上 DSpark 允许 num_speculative_tokens < dspark_block_size 的配置通过校验并进入模型执行。若 Ascend 的 DSpark 实现仍依赖 block-size 保证（原注释指出会产生乱码输出），需要在 AscendConfig 或 NPUPlatform.check_and_update_config 中补充等效校验，或验证小 speculative 长度下的输出正确性。
ascend_impact.testing: vllm-ascend 若有 DSpark 相关测试，需要补充 num_speculative_tokens 小于 dspark_block_size 的用例以验证 Ascend 侧行为符合预期。

将 bind_kv_cache 中针对同一 decoder block 内多个 attention 层共享相同 layer index（encoder-decoder 模型如 BART）的平台能力判断重构为 Platform 新类方法 check_runner_kv_caches_multi_layer()：基类默认抛 NotImplementedError，CUDA/ROCm/XPU/CPU 平台覆盖为 no-op。对 OOT 平台（含 Ascend）而言，行为与重构前完全一致——此前非 CUDA-alike/XPU/CPU 平台同样走 else 分支抛 NotImplementedError，现在由基类默认实现抛出，因此无行为回归。同时为支持该场景的平台提供了清晰的扩展点。

ascend_impact.functionality: vllm/platforms/interface.py（必然影响路径）新增非抽象类方法 check_runner_kv_caches_multi_layer()，默认抛 NotImplementedError；vllm/v1/worker/utils.py 的 bind_kv_cache 改为调用 current_platform.check_runner_kv_caches_multi_layer()。NPUPlatform 未覆盖此方法，行为与变更前一致（多 attention 层共享 layer index 时抛 NotImplementedError），不破坏现有 Ascend 编译与运行。但若 vllm-ascend 后续要支持 encoder-decoder 模型（BART 类）或已支持但此前依赖该报错拦截，需要显式 override 该方法为 no-op 以声明 runner_kv_caches 不受影响。
ascend_impact.testing: 无直接影响；Ascend 无需因该重构变更测试。

commits.message:
[Platform] Add check_runner_kv_caches_multi_layer (#51633)

Signed-off-by: wangxiyuan <wangxiyuan1007@gmail.com>

affected_interfaces: Platform.check_runner_kv_caches_multi_layer (new classmethod on vllm Platform interface; NPUPlatform in vllm_ascend/platform.py:78 inherits the fail-closed default that raises NotImplementedError)
vllm/v1/worker/utils.py::bind_kv_cache (upstream inline platform check replaced by the new platform hook; vllm-ascend fully replaces this function via vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_bind_kv_cache.py)
vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_bind_kv_cache.py (the ascend monkey-patch that skips the multi-layer raise now becomes redundant and is the natural removal target once the hook is overridden)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) Add a no-op classmethod override to NPUPlatform in vllm_ascend/platform.py so it no longer inherits the raising default: `@classmethod def check_runner_kv_caches_multi_layer(cls) -> None: pass`. This is legitimate because vllm-ascend has already verified its runner_kv_caches handling of multiple attention layers sharing a layer index (it currently skips the raise in patch_bind_kv_cache.py, which handles e.g. BART encoder-decoder self/cross attention). 2) After adding the override and validating encoder-decoder models (e.g. BART) on NPU, remove the now-redundant patch vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_bind_kv_cache.py, its registration in vllm_ascend/patch/worker/__init__.py (entry 18 in patch/__init__.py), and the import/assignment in vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_attn_utils.py, so the upstream bind_kv_cache (which now delegates to the platform hook) can run unpatched. Verify callers vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py:3760 and vllm_ascend/_310p/model_runner_310p.py:718 continue to work. 3) Update the bind_kv_cache entry in vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py accordingly.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. No immediate functional breakage: vllm-ascend monkey-patches bind_kv_cache entirely, so the new platform hook is never invoked on Ascend and the signature is unchanged. Residual risks: (a) if the ascend patch is removed before the NPUPlatform override is added, bind_kv_cache would raise NotImplementedError for any model with multiple attention layers sharing a layer index (encoder-decoder models); (b) NPUPlatform inherits a fail-closed default, so any future upstream caller of check_runner_kv_caches_multi_layer would fail on Ascend until the override exists; (c) the static copy of bind_kv_cache in patch_bind_kv_cache.py can drift from upstream, which this commit makes more likely to matter for future multi-layer handling.

commits.comment: 为 Kimi-K3 序列并行新增 SM100 BF16 GEMM-RS 内核：将 GEMM（row-parallel 投影）与 TP reduce-scatter 融合为单个 kernel，基于 CUTLASS cuTe DSL 实现，使用 NCCL symmetric memory multicast、multimem.ld_reduce 等 SM100/NVLink 特性，并配套新增 mbarrier 辅助 DSL、to_cta0_smem 工具、benchmark 脚本和分布式测试。功能接线覆盖 attention O-proj（KimiK3DeltaAttention / MultiHeadLatentAttention）和共享专家/MLP down-proj（KimiMLP/KimiMoE/KimiDecoderLayer），全部由默认关闭的 VLLM_KIMI_K3_GEMM_RS 环境变量控制。安全性设计较完善：maybe_init_gemm_rs 对 SP 是否开启、ubatching、dtype、平台（CUDA）、SM100 算力、TP 规模（2-16 且整除 128）做硬校验，can_run 校验权重 shape/dtype/连续性，should_run 对小 M 退回常规路径；同时为 shard_sequence_parallel_mlp 增加 eligible 参数，避免 FusedMoE 路径持有 reduction 时仍做 GEMM-RS 分片。风险点在于 kernel 内部 producer/consumer flag 协议和 peer-flag 内存语义复杂（依赖 CUTLASS 分布式 GEMM-RS 的内存语义约定），但 opt-in 开关+SM100 限定+运行时 fallback 将爆炸半径控制在 NVIDIA 专用路径内。注意：变更中修改的 vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/ 与 vllm/cute_utils/ 均属于 NVIDIA 专用路径。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更全部位于 NVIDIA/SM100 专用路径：vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/ 是 Kimi-K3 的 NVIDIA 实现目录，vllm/cute_utils/ 是 CUDA 专属 cuTE DSL 工具，新增内核使用 cuda.bindings、cutlass、torch.cuda 与 NCCL symmetric memory；vllm/envs.py 新增的 VLLM_KIMI_K3_GEMM_RS 默认关闭且仅被 nvidia 路径读取。未触及 Platform、WorkerBase、GPUModelRunner、AttentionBackend、DeviceCommunicatorBase、SchedulerInterface 等任何 Ascend 继承接口。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。新增测试 tests/kernels/test_kimi_k3_gemm_rs.py 带有 current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100) 跳过条件，仅 SM100/CUDA 运行；tests/models/kimi_k3/test_sequence_parallel.py 的修改只影响 NVIDIA Kimi-K3 模型路径，Ascend 不执行这些用例。
